'''Brick''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[TIE pilot]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], he was stationed aboard the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Vengeance II|''Vengeance'']], where he showed [[Flight Cadet]] [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] around the concourse of the ship.<ref name="Stele Chronicles" />
